name: Camping 101: Fishing
summary: Lee Brown teaches novice anglers near Goldshire how to use their fishing skill around camp. With simple catches and basic materials, they can make useful additions for a campsite.

sections.title: Campcraft for Anglers
sections.body: Fishing can feed you on the road and add comfort to camp. A fish bowl lifts the spirits of weary travelers between excursions. A sound mind and high spirits help make formidable fighters.

sections.title: Lee Brown's Expertise
sections.body: Lee Brown waits beside the waters outside Goldshire for fishermen ready to broaden their craft. Show him your skill with rod and line, and he can teach you to make useful additions for camp.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Lee Brown near Goldshire directs aspiring fishermen. After you show basic skill at fishing, he teaches you to make camp items such as a fish bowl for roadside campsites.
Lee Brown is a fishing trainer beside Crystal Lake, just outside Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He teaches angling and how fishermen can make items for camp.

faq.q: What does a Fish Bowl do for a campsite?
faq.answer: A fish bowl brings comfort and joy to a campsite. Pleasant surroundings lift morale and help adventurers feel ready and capable when facing the wilderness.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The training takes place in Elwynn Forest, beside the waters around Goldshire where local anglers gather.

faq.q: Do I need prior skill in fishing to complete this?
faq.answer: Yes. Lee Brown teaches travelers who have practiced casting and shown basic skill at fishing.
Yes. A well-kept camp offers comfort that improves an adventurer's physical and mental preparedness, resilience, and effectiveness in combat in the field.

angles.text: As a human traveler starting out in Elwynn Forest, you can learn wilderness self-sufficiency beside the familiar waters of Goldshire.
